name: read a man page to determine the tool's capability
definition: use the available manual to identify features/options of the command before applying the strongest setting.
failure_mode: guessing the option wrong yields the wrong ciphertext

name: read every hand file and aggregate per-hand results
definition: iterate the jsons in the directory and evaluate each its own tile multiset
failure_mode: skipped a file or parse transfer mangles a result line

name: read matlab source and preserve its numeric behavior
definition: inspect a given script and reproduce the same array-construction and path semantic choices in python
failure_mode: order/concat semantics differ yields mismatched arrays

name: redirect primary input and stdio through the evaluator
definition: Have the evaluator read a path as its first stdin line, then it reroutes all remaining stdin to the interpreted program so read-based programs see the same input the reference would; its printed output goes to stdout.
